faq_heading: Homes near Theresa Clarke Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Theresa Clarke Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Theresa Clarke Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Theresa Clarke Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Theresa Clarke Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 88 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,305,000, condos $401,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Theresa Clarke Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Theresa Clarke Elementary the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 88 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Theresa Clarke Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are K B Woodward Elementary (0.6 km south), Kwantlen Park Secondary (0.9 km south) and Bridgeview Elementary (1.4 km north).

Theresa Clarke Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13104 109 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Theresa Clarke Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Theresa Clarke Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Theresa Clarke Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Theresa Clarke Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 88 homes sold within 1 km of Theresa Clarke Elementary: 22 houses, 2 townhomes and 64 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $401,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Theresa Clarke Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Theresa Clarke Elementary in a straight line (14 elementary, 4 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is K B Woodward Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Guildford Park Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Kwantlen Park Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: K B Woodward Elementary (0.6 km south), Bridgeview Elementary (1.4 km north), James Ardiel Elementary (1.5 km north-east), Old Yale Road Elementary (1.5 km south), Khalsa School Old Yale Road (1.5 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is K B Woodward Elementary, 0.6 km south of Theresa Clarke Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Theresa Clarke Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Theresa Clarke Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Theresa Clarke Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Theresa Clarke Elementary was $401,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at K B Woodward Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.6 km south of Theresa Clarke Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
